source.title: The Fourth Turning, Tested (Oct 17, 2026); How AI Changes the Fourth Turning (Oct 2026); Family Preparedness Plan (Oct 18, 2026)
source.note: Probabilities are one analysis's estimates, not data or market prices. Use them as a checklist of what to watch, not a schedule.

bottomLine: The most likely decade is chronic stress with no single decisive climax. AI makes it more volatile: a likely bust trigger, a squeeze on young office workers, and new state and corporate power. Watch your own costs, income and credit, not the national mood.

scenarios.name: Chronic stress, no climax
scenarios.what: Checks and balances erode, violence stays elevated but sporadic, the Iran conflict freezes, debt passes the 1946 record. Closer to the 1970s than to 1861 or 1941.
scenarios.signals: Crises that each fade; narrow alternating elections; national mood stays below the hard data.

scenarios.name: Crisis with a national rally
scenarios.what: A war or a crash forces national mobilization; a new coalition forms, debt is inflated down, the state expands.
scenarios.signals: A clear rally in polls; bipartisan emergency laws; a 2028 landslide; trust rising after 2030.

scenarios.name: Crisis without a rally (rupture)
scenarios.what: A shock splits the country instead of uniting it: a disputed election, defiance of courts, state-federal standoffs, prolonged unrest. Not civil war.
scenarios.signals: Governors refusing federal orders; the executive defying a final court ruling; money leaving Treasuries.

scenarios.name: Early calm
scenarios.what: AI productivity gains, an Iran settlement and a 2028 realignment lower stress without a crisis.
scenarios.signals: National mood rises to meet the hard data; violence falls.

shocksTogether: Every true US crisis paired deep division with a war or a financial collapse at the same time. Watch bank, bond and war signals alongside unrest: two areas turning red together matters more than any one reading.

dates.title: ACA open enrollment begins
dates.why: Compare health plans on total yearly cost. An IRS proposed rule on the premium tax credit is open for comment until Nov 30.

dates.title: Chinese military drill season around Taiwan
dates.why: November and December are the peak season for large drills. There has been no large drill around Taiwan since December 2025.

dates.title: Midterm elections
dates.why: The pledge of no Iran strikes runs to this date, so oil and gas risk may rise after it.

dates.title: Checkpoint: re-check stages after the midterms
dates.why: Did the election pass with a normal count and no defiance of courts? Step down anything you can't justify with a number.

dates.title: Comments close on the premium tax credit rule
dates.why: Last day to comment on the IRS proposed rule published Oct 15.

dates.title: Automatic Selective Service registration begins
dates.why: Men 18 to 25 are registered automatically under the FY2026 defense law. This is registration, not a draft.

dates.title: US-China trade truce lapses unless renewed
dates.why: A lapse with no renewal is an early Taiwan-crisis signal (H6). Watch electronics prices and chip-related layoffs.

dates.title: Checkpoint: re-check stages after the trade truce date
dates.why: Was the US-China truce renewed? A lapse with tariffs snapping back moves War and Taiwan to Prepare.

dates.title: Doomsday Clock announcement
dates.why: Set at 85 seconds to midnight in January 2026, the closest ever.

dates.title: Next V-Dem democracy report
dates.why: Shows whether checks on the president kept falling (H3).

dates.title: Hurricane season starts
dates.why: Check flood insurance well before: new federal flood policies usually take 30 days to start.

dates.title: Iran frozen-settlement test resolves
dates.why: Did a ceasefire hold 90+ days with Hormuz open? Drives gas and airfare (H7).

dates.title: Presidential election
dates.why: The new-coalition test (H2) and the date one cycle model picks for a reset.

dates.title: End of FY2030: projected debt record
dates.why: CBO projects debt held by the public passes the 1946 record of 106.1% of GDP this year (H4a).

dates.title: Social Security retirement trust fund runs out (CBO)
dates.why: Without a new law, benefits drop to what incoming payroll taxes cover.

tests.name: A climax event
tests.resolvesYesIf: 1,000+ US military deaths in one war in a year; US and Chinese forces exchange fire; Insurrection Act troops kept in a state 30+ days over its governor's objection; or the Treasury misses a debt payment
tests.householdSignal: Gas prices and deployment notices; local National Guard call-ups

tests.name: A durable new coalition
tests.resolvesYesIf: One party wins the 2028 presidency by 7+ points and holds the White House, House and Senate after the 2030 midterms
tests.householdSignal: Whether local politics stops flipping

tests.name: Executive power keeps growing
tests.resolvesYesIf: V-Dem's legislative-constraints score for the US in the 2029 report is lower than in the 2026 report
tests.householdSignal: Benefits or programs changed by executive order without a law; staff cuts at Social Security field offices

tests.name: Debt passes the 1946 record
tests.resolvesYesIf: Debt held by the public exceeds 106.1% of GDP at the end of any fiscal year
tests.householdSignal: Rising mortgage and car-loan rates; savings paying well below inflation

tests.name: Debt inflated away
tests.resolvesYesIf: After its peak, debt/GDP falls 10+ points by 2036 with average CPI above 4%
tests.householdSignal: Savings paying well below inflation

tests.name: Inequality falls
tests.resolvesYesIf: Top 1% share of household net worth below 30% in the Fed's Distributional Financial Accounts
tests.householdSignal: A market drop that hits 401(k)s; new top-wealth tax laws

tests.name: Taiwan blockade
tests.resolvesYesIf: China blockades or quarantines Taiwan, stopping commercial shipping 7+ days in a row
tests.householdSignal: Electronics prices and shortages; chip-related layoffs

tests.name: Taiwan invasion
tests.resolvesYesIf: China launches an amphibious invasion of Taiwan
tests.householdSignal: A market crash; electronics shortages

tests.name: US-China exchange of fire
tests.resolvesYesIf: US and Chinese forces exchange fire
tests.householdSignal: Market and shipping shock

tests.name: Iran frozen
tests.resolvesYesIf: A US-Iran ceasefire holds 90+ days in a row with Hormuz open, without a signed nuclear deal
tests.householdSignal: Gasoline prices; airline fares

tests.name: An AI Manhattan Project
tests.resolvesYesIf: Congress appropriates $50B+ in one year to a federally directed AI program, or the Defense Production Act is used to direct frontier labs
tests.verdict: Unsure (the state is already coercing labs through procurement and export rules)
tests.householdSignal: Data-center electricity costs on utility bills

tests.name: AI stock bust
tests.resolvesYesIf: The Nasdaq-100 falls 35%+ from a peak within any 12 months
tests.verdict: Unsure (record concentration; capex near or above cash flow)
tests.householdSignal: 401(k) balances; layoffs at AI firms; tech stocks 20% or more below their high

tests.name: Political violence stays elevated
tests.resolvesYesIf: An assassination or attempt on a federal official, governor or presidential candidate in 2027-28, and fewer such incidents in 2029-31 than 2025-27
tests.householdSignal: Threats to school boards and election offices; polling-place security

tests.name: Youth turn toward duty
tests.resolvesYesIf: Every service meets recruiting goals in FY2027-29 and young adults' trust in the military is higher in 2029 than 2026
tests.householdSignal: Recruiter activity in local schools

tests.name: A Millennial president
tests.resolvesYesIf: A president born in 1982 or later is inaugurated
tests.householdSignal: None directly

tests.name: Recent-graduate jobless rate hits 7%
tests.resolvesYesIf: NY Fed unemployment for recent college graduates (22 to 27) is 7.0% or higher in any quarter
tests.householdSignal: Fewer entry-level offers; internships not turning into jobs

tests.name: Federal law overrides state AI laws
tests.resolvesYesIf: A federal statute preempting state AI laws is enacted
tests.householdSignal: State protections on chatbots and children stop being enforced

tests.name: AI-enabled cyberattack on US infrastructure
tests.resolvesYesIf: An officially attributed AI-enabled cyberattack causes multi-day disruption to US critical infrastructure
tests.householdSignal: Utility, hospital or bank outages; emergency patch notices

tests.name: Power bills outpace inflation three years running
tests.resolvesYesIf: CPI electricity rises faster than CPI all items in each of 2026, 2027 and 2028
tests.householdSignal: Monthly bill and rate-case notices

tests.name: Antitrust case against a frontier AI lab or Nvidia
tests.resolvesYesIf: DOJ or FTC files an antitrust complaint against a frontier lab or Nvidia
tests.householdSignal: Headlines; little direct effect

tests.name: Deepfake swings a federal race
tests.resolvesYesIf: A credibly reported deepfake changes the outcome of a federal race
tests.householdSignal: Viral fake audio in the final week

tests.name: AI does a month of work unattended
tests.resolvesYesIf: METR's 50% time horizon reaches 167 hours (one work month)
tests.householdSignal: AI agents doing week-long projects at work

baseRates.name: US civil war (1,000+ battle deaths) by 2031

standingPrep: Keep about six months of essential expenses in cash or savings you can reach quickly.
Know how much of your retirement savings rides on a handful of large tech stocks.
Review insurance coverage and deductibles before each renewal.
Keep bank deposits within FDIC insurance: $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, per ownership category.
Save your state's unemployment and benefits links, and 211.org for local help, before you need them.
scenarioNote: Updated Oct 2026 for AI (was A 50, B 20, C 22, D 8). If AI is transformative and its owners capture government, rupture (C) becomes the most likely at about 45%.
